audit_metadata.title: Audit 4: Deep Security & Architectural Verification Audit
audit_metadata.lead_auditor: Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer & Enterprise Security Architect
audit_metadata.phase_assessed: Phase 4: Municipal Threat Intelligence Feed, STIX 2.1 Export & Next.js 15 Analyst Dashboard

nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.verification: 100% of AI inference executes locally within sovereign UAE compute; zero offshore API calls; Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API with UAE Local Storage enabled

fr_3_3_webhook_latency_sla.verification: FastAPI gateway acknowledges incoming webhooks in < 50ms with HTTP 200 via Celery background queue decoupling

fr_4_1_class_a_vs_class_b_segregation.verification: Class A indicators (malicious URLs, domains, foreign numbers) persisted indefinitely; citizen numbers pseudonymized via HMAC-SHA256 with 32-byte salt; ephemeral 60s queue TTL

fr_4_3_threat_feed_pii_exclusion.verification: Municipal threat feeds expose strictly Class A threat telemetry; zero citizen user hashes, raw phone numbers, or submitter identifiers exposed; verified by test_zero_class_b_pii_leakage

protocol_rule_11_air_gapped_zero_saas.verification: 100% self-contained static assets in Next.js 15; zero external CDNs or Google Fonts; decoupled 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas Mel-Spectrogram engine via requestAnimationFrame; bounded 100-entry UI ring buffer

fr_1_4_conformal_calibration.verification: Non-parametric conformal prediction bounds False Positive Rate at <= 0.1% (alpha=0.001, tau=0.85); routes statistical ambiguity to Amber (Abstain)

fr_1_5_audio_duration_cap.verification: Strict 120-second payload duration ceiling enforced; voice notes > 120s rejected prior to GPU queue dispatch

nfr_1_3_anti_reconnaissance.verification: Citizen token-bucket rate limit (5 req/hr per citizen hash) via atomic Redis Lua script evaluation

resolved_observations.title: Atomic Lua Script for Rate Limiting
Guaranteed RAM Purge via try...finally Block
Active Health Readiness Probe (PostgreSQL & Redis)
resolved_observations.remediation: api/v1/health.py actively executes SELECT 1 on database and PING on Redis, emitting HTTP 503 if unreachable

resolved_observations.title: Meta Media CDN URL Hostname SSRF Validation
resolved_observations.remediation: services/media_downloader.py strictly validates Meta CDN hostnames against whitelist (*.facebook.com, *.fbcdn.net, *.fbsbx.com, *.whatsapp.net)

resolved_observations.title: Dedicated Worker Queue Separation for Text vs Media
resolved_observations.remediation: Celery routes and docker-compose.yml partitioned into hares-worker-text (high_priority_triage) and hares-worker-media (media_triage)

resolved_observations.title: Centralized Log Formatter Phone Scrubber
resolved_observations.remediation: core/logging.py implements PhoneSanitizingFilter globally stripping phone numbers from all log records and tracebacks

new_observations.title: Threat Feed API Rate Limiting per Analyst Key
new_observations.description: Municipal Threat Feed API currently relies exclusively on API key authentication without a request rate ceiling.
new_observations.recommendation: Implement a token-bucket rate limiter (e.g. 100 requests/minute per analyst API key) to protect against runaway municipal SIEM scrapers.

new_observations.title: Strict Production CORS Origin Enforcement
new_observations.description: CORS_ORIGINS defaults to localhost:3000 in development. In production, exact municipal domain names should be mandated.
new_observations.recommendation: Add a configuration validator requiring CORS_ORIGINS to disallow localhost when ENVIRONMENT == 'production'.

new_observations.title: Cryptographic Digital Signatures on Exported STIX 2.1 Bundles
new_observations.description: STIX 2.1 export generates unsigned standard JSON bundles. Inter-agency sharing across DESC and TDRA would benefit from object-level non-repudiation.
new_observations.recommendation: Implement an optional detached ECDSA signature header (X-Hares-Bundle-Signature) on exported STIX feeds.
